definitions.explanation: A company officer, required in many Japanese {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ} (joint-stock companies), who oversees how the directors perform their duties and audits the company's accounts. A statutory role distinct from an outside accounting firm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{監査役|かんさやく}だ。
examples.english: He is the company's statutory auditor.

examples.japanese: {監査役|かんさやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}する→監督する：21986_kantokusuru⟧。
examples.english: The statutory auditor oversees the directors' performance of their duties.

examples.japanese: {監査役|かんさやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: The statutory auditor checks, from an independent position, whether the directors are managing the company properly.

notes:
A statutory officer of a Japanese joint-stock company who audits the directors' conduct and the company's finances. Distinct from a ⟦{会計士|かいけいし}→会計士：06083_kaikeishi⟧ (an outside accountant).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {監査役|かんさやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as a statutory auditor
- {社外|しゃがい}{監査役|かんさやく}: an outside (non-employee) auditor
- {監査役|かんさやく}{会|かい}: the board of company auditors
